title: League Championship Series: 2024 Rebrand
tagline: Rebuilding North America's premier League of Legends league into a brand where players make their name.

hero.alt: LCS reflective apparel lit by a single spotlight against black — the brand's core idea of shining a light on all-star players.

body: The LCS is North America's top League of Legends competition, but its identity no longer matched its ambition. It needed to stand shoulder to shoulder with traditional sports leagues while feeling unmistakably native to gaming — and it had to hold up everywhere, from a stadium finals stage to a phone screen mid-match.

The hardest part: ten pro teams, each with fierce fan bases and loud color palettes, all living under one league brand. The system had to unify them without flattening them — and keep the players, not the logo, as the stars of the show.

feature.caption: Out-of-home — the identity carried into the physical world.
feature.alt: LCS out-of-home poster panels installed in a concrete concourse.

body: We built the brand around a single organizing idea: the LCS is a spotlight illuminating the all-star characters who fuel the league — 'where you make your name.' That concept drove everything, starting with a new logo mark that reads as both a rising arrow and a beam of light pointing to the top.

From there I directed a full, end-to-end system: a bold PP Formula Condensed typographic voice, a neutral core palette engineered so the ten team colors could always be the loudest thing on screen, a 'Superstar Energy' art-direction and photography language, a modular grid, a broadcast graphics package with a signature live ticker device, and extensions across apparel, out-of-home, social, and digital.

The result is a 148-page brand system covering strategy, tone of voice, logo, type, color, art direction, graphic language, broadcast, and brand extensions — a single source of truth the whole league could build on.
led: Owned creative direction across the entire brand development
Defined brand strategy, tone of voice, and the core 'make your name' concept
Directed the logo suite, typography, and team-inclusive color system
Set the 'Superstar Energy' art direction and photography language
Designed the broadcast graphics package and live ticker device
Extended the system into apparel, OOH, social, and digital
